title: Minimum Number of Increasing Subsequence to Be Removed
description:
Given an array of integers `nums`, you are allowed to perform the following operation any number of times:

	Remove a **strictly increasing** subsequence from the array.

Your task is to find the **minimum** number of operations required to make the array **empty**.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Minimum Number of Increasing Subsequence to Be Removed.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
